violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. OBSERVED NO CERTIFIED FOOD MANAGER ONSITE AT TIME OF INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. PIC UNDERSTANDS A CFM MUST BE ONSITE DURING ALL HOURS OF FOOD OPERATION. PLEASE ENSURE MORE STAFF OBTAIN A CERTIFICATION BY THE TIME OF THE FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION OR THAT CERTIFIED FOOD STAFF ARE ABLE TO BE ONSITE DURING ALL HOURS OF FOOD OPERATION.
